p50 vs p95 again, quick

p50 is the median: half of payouts are faster than it. p95 is the value 95% are faster than, so it shows the slow tail. A good p50 with a bad p95 means most merchants are fine but a few wait a long time.
biscuit's scratching like crazy again

Poor guy. Common causes in beagles: fleas (check the base of the tail and belly for black specks), a new food or treat, or seasonal allergies from wet leaves this time of year. Look for red patches or broken skin. If it's keeping him up or he's chewing himself raw, a vet visit is worth it this week.
how long does a flare like that usually last

If it's something he ate, itching usually settles one to two weeks after the trigger is gone, though full skin recovery can take up to eight weeks. Flea bites calm within days once treated. Anything with open sores or a smell should be seen sooner.
